text:
Situation: Ursodiol 300 mg capsules are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Strides Pharma Inc. posted a discontinuation of its ursodiol capsule on 2026-04-06, but the product remains off the current shortage list. Corvale General holds 303 capsules, providing 31.6 days of supply at the current usage rate.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include ursodiol as of 2026-10-21. Strides Pharma Inc. posted a discontinuation of its ursodiol capsule on 2026-04-06.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one month. Multiple alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today, though their labels do not name plants that can be placed for sourcing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC (needs: buyer approval).
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Aurobindo Pharma Limited (needs: buyer approval).
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with AvKARE (needs: buyer approval).
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with AvPAK (needs: buyer approval).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
